metric: scripts/metrics.py metric_suite / tpr_at_fpr (TPR at FPR=1e-3, full ROC with drop_intermediate=False, np.interp); thresholds from metrics.operating_threshold on the same curve
notes: Baseline A has no per-checkpoint series (only step 8000 stored).

definitions.detrended_b_linfit_resid: sqrt(sum(resid^2)/(n-2)) after a least-squares line in step
definitions.lag1_autocorr_resid: sum(e_t e_t+1)/sum(e_t^2) of the linear-fit residuals
definitions.sigma_folds1_4: mean over folds 1-4 of the per-fold detrended sd
definitions.old_ratio: raw fold-0 32-point checkpoint sd of each arm / |gap|
definitions.gap: fold-mean TPR difference, folds 1-4, D1, single checkpoints
definitions.window: k consecutive stored checkpoints, mean_logit combination, every valid position (analyze_window_average's scatter-reduction positions); sd_1 taken at the same positions (each window's last checkpoint)
definitions.white_noise_expectation_for_estimator_a: for an overlapping k-window mean of independent noise, successive window means differ by (x_new - x_old)/k, so estimator (a) shrinks by k, not sqrt(k); this column states that analytic expectation and is not a measurement
